author: National Geographic
description:
When 33 miners became trapped more than half a mile underground in northern Chile, the entire world held its breath. Over 69 days, rescuers raced to try to save them while the men underground fought to survive.

Featuring unseen archive footage and powerful interviews with survivors and rescuers, this documentary series tells the definitive story of one of history's most compelling disasters.
